comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Staging p95 is 251ms after the parallel split. Shipping with the feature flag default on.

content.text: Staging p95 is 251ms after the parallel split. Shipping with the feature flag default on.

The dashboard data loader issued sequential queries for boards, members, and activity, totaling ~640ms p95 on warm cache. That waterfall blocked first contentful paint for the board shell even when each individual query was cheap.

Split loadDashboardBootstrap into three parallel queries sharing a composite cache key workspace:{id}:dash:v3 with a 45-second TTL. Member and activity slices may stale-serve while boards always revalidate on focus.
Complete when the bootstrap path is under 280ms p95 on staging with the shared key, and cache invalidation still fires on board create/archive events.
